lines.1: 「I have yet to inspect your room.」
lines.2: 「What I find will determine your schedule for tomorrow.」
lines.3: 「Meaning that if it's a mess, I'll be cleaning it?」
lines.5: 「A room should be kept as sanitary as possible.」
lines.9: 「It is tidier than I expected. There is no problem.」
lines.10: Why did she sound a little disappointed?
lines.11: 「I expected to find one or two posters of your favorite idols.」
lines.12: 「No. Whenever I put one up, Crab goes...」
lines.13: 「So you like 'em stacked?! Is that it?! Big boobs--that's all you want, just lumps of fat?! Men are all the same!」
lines.14: 「She gets openly furious about breasts out of pure jealousy, so I stopped putting posters up.」
lines.15: 「Heh. That only proves how attached she is to you.」
lines.18: 「I suppose it is. I will not call it bad.」
lines.19: 「Still, you should read a little more literature too. Saneatsu Mushanokoji would be a fine choice.」
